    "Lacks advanced project management features like automations or complex reporting",
    "Initial setup can be cumbersome with tools needing to be added manually",
    "Search functionality for old projects or specific items can be frustrating"

  "overall_experience": "This Founder likely found Basecamp to be a reliable and effective tool for basic project organization and team communication within their small business. They appreciated its ability to centralize information and streamline workflows, reducing reliance on disparate communication channels. While its simplicity was a strength, they likely encountered limitations with advanced features and some initial setup friction, but ultimately found it delivered good value for its core purpose."
